description: Use this when someone wants popular or trending songs to put on a Reel, TikTok or Story for a business in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia or the UAE, for example 'what songs are trending in Malaysia for Reels?'. Returns this week's songs charting on both Apple Music and Spotify in that country, with the trend (new, up, down) and whether a business account can use them. It is a music-chart signal, not a count of Reels or TikTok uses. Every song is marked business use 'unknown' with the platform's official rule: say so, and never tell a business a song is cleared. Not for picking royalty-free music or for countries outside the list.

country.description: Country name or 2-letter code, e.g. Malaysia or MY

platform.description: Which app the post is for (changes the business-account rule shown). Default any.

name: trending_audio
